note: 複數去 y 加 ies：babies；常見搭配 baby boy / baby girl
example: The baby is sleeping peacefully in the crib.

note: 母音+y結尾，複數直接加 s：boys
example: The boy likes to play basketball with his friends.

note: 可數名詞，複數為 girls
example: She is a smart and polite junior high school girl.

note: ★會考大重點！不規則複數為 children [ˋtʃɪldrən]，不可寫 childs
example: Every child deserves love, care, and a good education.

note: ★會考常考不規則複數：men [mɛn]，母音 a 轉 e
example: That tall man standing by the door is our teacher.

note: ★會考必考不規則複數：women [ˋwɪmɪn]，注意讀音變化
example: She is a kind, wise, and hardworking woman.

note: 日常複數通通用 people [ˋpip!]；persons 僅用於正式法律公文
example: She is a very responsible and caring person.

note: 常見片語：make friends with (和...交朋友)；friendly (adj. 友善的)
example: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

note: 複合字：class (班級) + mate (夥伴)，複數加 s
example: He is my best classmate in junior high school.

note: 可數名詞，美式拼法 neighbor，英式拼法 neighbour
example: Our neighbors are very kind and friendly to us.

note: 可數名詞；常與 be my guest (請便、別客氣) 連用
example: We welcomed several guests to our home for dinner.

note: 源自 strange (奇怪的/陌生的) + er；注意片語 don't talk to strangers
example: Never give your private information to a stranger.

note: 指家庭時視為單數；指家人全體成員時常視為複數
example: I love spending quality time with my family on weekends.

note: 單數指父或母一人；指父母雙方務必用複數 parents
example: My parents always encourage me to do my best.

note: 口語常稱 dad 或 daddy
example: My father drives me to school every morning.

note: 口語常稱 mom 或 mommy
example: My mother makes the most delicious breakfast for us.

note: 年長加 elder / older brother；年幼加 younger brother
example: My elder brother is studying hard for his exams.

note: 年長加 elder / older sister；年幼加 younger sister
example: I often share secrets and stories with my sister.

note: 與太陽 sun 同音 [sʌn]，注意拼法別搞混
example: They are very proud of their kind and polite son.

note: 注意 gh 不發音，拼寫常考；複數加 s
example: Their daughter is good at English and likes drawing cats.

note: 開頭音標為母音 [ʌ]，冠詞要用 an uncle
example: My uncle bought me a cute cat notebook yesterday.

note: 開頭音標為母音 [æ]，冠詞要用 an aunt
example: My aunt is a warm-hearted teacher.

note: 英文不分男女與年長年幼，堂或表親皆稱為 cousin
example: I will visit my cousins in Tainan this weekend.

note: 口語常稱 grandpa 或 granddad
example: My grandfather tells wonderful stories about his childhood.

note: 口語常稱 grandma 或 granny
example: My grandmother grows beautiful flowers in her garden.
